bagPolicy.summary: Clear bags up to 14" x 6" x 14" and small clutches up to 4.5" x 6.5" are allowed. The arena asks guests not to bring a bag.
allowed: Clear bags up to 14" x 6" x 14"
Small clutches, purses or wallets up to 4.5" x 6.5" (need not be clear)
prohibited: Any bag outside the size limits
bagPolicy.note: Diaper bag items must be placed in a clear plastic bag for entry. No bag check is listed.

parking.note: Parking availability, access routes, and pricing at CFG Bank Arena can vary by event. Review the linked official information and reserve in advance when that option is offered.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in CFG Bank Arena's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at CFG Bank Arena varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: 2^{nd} Floor: Outside Center Club in concourse and 2^{nd} Floor west garage entrance (near ADA Section 101) CFG Bank Arena offers wheelchair accessible and low mobility seating on each level of the venue at comparable prices and sight-lines.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in CFG Bank Arena's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Will Call is located at the Arena’s main lobby at the intersection of Baltimore Street and Hopkins Plaza. The Ticketmaster Box Office is open Monday – Friday from 11:00am – 4:00pm *Holiday & Event day hours may vary

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at CFG Bank Arena. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
